faq.questionAr: هل أوردرز هاوس منصة موثوقة، وهل يتم الاعتراف بالخدمات المقدَّمة من خلالها؟
faq.questionEn: Is OrderzHouse a reliable platform, and are the services offered through it recognised?
faq.answerEn:
OrderzHouse operates under clear policies and procedures for regulating orders, delivery, modifications, evaluation, and handling complaints and disputes. The user can follow the status of his order and keep a record of correspondence and deliveries through his account on the platform.

Recognition of the service or work carried out by an employer, educational institution, or official body is subject to the terms and policies of the concerned party, and OrderzHouse does not guarantee acceptance of the service as an academic qualification, professional certificate, or official accreditation, unless this is explicitly stated in the service description.

We therefore recommend keeping all correspondence, agreements, deliveries and payments within the platform, and retaining invoices and proofs of delivery when needed.

faq.questionAr: هل تستحق خدمات المنصة المدفوعة التكلفة؟
faq.questionEn: Are paid platform services worth the cost?
faq.answerEn:
The value of the service depends on your needs, budget, project scope, and the experience of the freelancer you choose. OrderzHouse allows you to compare Bids, review freelancers' portfolios and ratings, and agree in advance the scope of work, duration, cost and desired deliverables before approving the order.

We recommend starting with a specific task or a small request to evaluate the quality of implementation and the extent of the freelancer's commitment, then expanding the scope of work after ensuring that the service suits your needs.

The Platform does not guarantee profits or specific business results from any Service, unless the order includes an express written agreement on measurable results.

faq.questionAr: ما ميزات الباقات أو الخيارات المتقدمة، وكيف أعرف ما إذا كانت مناسبة لي؟
faq.questionEn: What are the features of Membership Plans or advanced options, and how do I know if they're right for me?
faq.answerEn:
What are the features of Membership Plans or advanced options, and how do I know if they're right for me?

Benefits vary depending on the Membership Plan or option you choose, and may include a greater number of orders or services, additional account management tools, extended support or follow-up, and priority on certain services, as described on each Membership Plan's page at the time of signup.

Before subscribing, carefully review the Membership Plan's price, term, included services, usage limits, and renewal, cancellation, and refund terms. Choose the Membership Plan that suits your actual needs, the expected number of orders, and the nature of the business you wish to undertake.

Participation in any Membership Plan does not guarantee a specific number of orders, clients or profits, unless expressly stated in a written offer approved by the platform. The Membership Plan details shown upon completion of the subscription remain part of the agreement between the user and the platform.

faq.questionAr: هل تتوفر موارد أو إرشادات مجانية للمستخدمين؟
faq.questionEn: Are there free resources or guidance available to users?
faq.answerEn:
Yes, OrderzHouse provides free how-to content to help users understand how to use the platform, create orders, select freelancers, define the scope of work, and manage delivery and modifications.

You can refer to the help section, FAQ, demo pages, and blog for available instructions and updates. This content may be updated or new resources added from time to time.

Instructional content is provided for general awareness and assistance purposes, and is not a substitute for professional legal, financial, technical, or professional advice.

faq.questionAr: ما أكثر أنواع الطلبات شيوعًا على المنصة؟
faq.questionEn: What are the most popular types of orders on the platform?
faq.answerEn:
The most active order types vary based on user needs, seasons, freelancer availability, and market trends. Common requests typically include areas such as programming, website and app development, design, content writing, digital marketing, data entry, and other professional services.

You can browse currently available categories and orders to see which areas are the most active in real time.

The platform does not guarantee the continued level of demand in any specialty, and the number of available opportunities may vary from time to time.

faq.questionAr: كيف تساعدني المنصة في إيجاد مستقل مناسب وإتمام مشروعي؟
faq.questionEn: How does the platform help me find a suitable freelancer and complete my project?
faq.answerEn:
The process begins by defining the service classification, project description, required deliverables, budget, and delivery date. After publishing the request, it is directed to the appropriate freelancers according to their specializations and levels within the platform, and you can follow up on the request and communicate its details through the approved channels.

OrderzHouse adopts a “Ghost Team” system, where a team of freelancers and internal supervision may work behind each order without the need to show all team members to the client. This system helps monitor the quality of implementation and continuity of work, and allows the platform to address any shortcomings or stumbling internally, including requesting correction, supporting the freelancer, or redistributing the work to another freelancer when needed.

This mechanism aims to reduce the impact of operational problems on the client and maintain as much as possible the agreed upon deadline and quality. However, in some cases, the implementation duration may be affected by the nature of the project, additional modifications, lack of information, or circumstances beyond control, and the client will be notified when there is a material change in the delivery duration.

Freelancers within the platform are classified into the following categories:

General or Non-Certified Freelancer: A registered user who may apply for some of the available orders, but has not completed all of the certification, contracting, or verification requirements specified by the platform.
Certified Freelancer: A freelancer who has met specific requirements for accreditation, such as completing his file, accepting policies, signing the required contracts, and passing the evaluation or qualification procedures approved by the platform.
Certified and Verified Freelancer: A freelancer who has completed a higher level of verification and contracting, which may include verification of identity, professional data, contracts, obligations or subscriptions associated with the category, depending on the regulations in place at the time of registration.

The approved category for each freelancer appears within the platform when available, and these categories help organize selection and manage requests. Classification alone is not an absolute guarantee of the result, as the quality of implementation also depends on the clarity of the project scope, the experience of the freelancer in the required specialization, and the commitment of both parties to instructions and deadlines.

faq.questionAr: ما خدمات أوردرز هاوس للفرق والشركات، وكيف يتم تحديد الأسعار؟
faq.questionEn: What are OrderzHouse's services for teams and businesses, and how are prices determined?
faq.answerEn:
OrderzHouse provides customized solutions for teams and businesses that need to perform repetitive work, manage a large volume of orders, or handle more than one discipline within a single project. These solutions may include allocating a team of freelancers, managing and following up on requests, distributing tasks, supervising quality, preparing periodic reports, and providing a unified point of contact with the work team.

The price is determined based on the nature of the services required, the volume of work, the number of requests or hours of implementation, the specializations needed, the duration of the project, and the level of follow-up and support. Pricing may be per order, per stage, or within a monthly Membership Plan or special agreement.

The scope of work, cost, implementation period and payment terms are set out in a separate quotation or agreement before work commences. General or estimated prices do not constitute a final commitment unless approved by both parties in writing.

faq.questionAr: ما هو نظام «Ghost Team» في أوردرز هاوس؟
faq.questionEn: What is the “Ghost Team” system in OrderzHouse?
faq.answerEn:
The “Ghost Team” system is an internal operating mechanism that allows the platform to manage the request through a single freelancer or a specialized team working behind the request, without the need to show all team members to the client.

This system helps monitor the quality of implementation, provide support to the freelancer, and address any shortcomings or stumbling internally, including redistributing the work or hiring another freelancer when needed. The goal is to minimize the impact of operational problems on the client and to maintain as much as possible the quality and agreed delivery date.

faq.questionAr: ما أنواع المستقلين في أوردرز هاوس؟
faq.questionEn: What are the types of freelancers at OrderzHouse?
faq.answerEn:
OrderzHouse includes three main categories of freelancers:

General or non-certified freelancer: A user who is registered with the platform, but has not completed all certification, contracting, or verification requirements.

Certified Freelancer: A freelancer who has met the platform’s requirements, which may include completing a personal profile, accepting policies, signing required contracts, and passing an assessment or qualification.

Certified and Verified Freelancer: A freelancer who has completed a higher level of verification and contracting, which may include identity verification, professional data, contracts, subscriptions or obligations associated with their category.

These ratings help organize the distribution of orders and selection of freelancers, but are not an absolute guarantee of the outcome of each project.

faq.questionAr: أولًا: التسجيل والبدء في العمل ، كيف أبدأ العمل كمستقل على أوردرز هاوس؟
faq.questionEn: First: Register and start working. How do I start working as a freelancer on OrderzHouse?
faq.answerEn:
How do I start working as a freelancer on OrderzHouse?

You start by creating a freelance account, completing the required data, choosing the appropriate field of work, then completing the subscription, contracting and qualification procedures for your category. After activating the account, you can view the orders available for your category and apply for them or receive them according to the order distribution system in effect on the platform.

The platform may require identity verification, completion of a professional profile, acceptance of policies, and signing of an independent contract before allowing the receipt of orders or withdrawal of dues.

Can I work even if I have no previous experience?

Yes, some applicants can start without prior professional experience, provided they commit to training and qualification and pass the assessments determined by the platform.

OrderzHouse adopts a business model based on providing client orders and qualifying the freelancer to implement them. However, registration or subscription does not mean automatically passing the evaluation, nor does it guarantee obtaining a specific number of orders or achieving a fixed income.

Is the subscription mandatory to work on fixed price orders?

Yes, subscribing to the category designated for working on fixed-price orders is a requirement for activating the account and receiving these orders, according to the details of each category and the contract associated with it.

There are actual requests and clients on the platform, and the subscription allows the freelancer to enter the work system related to his category without waiting for independent approval from the client for each request, according to the request distribution mechanism.

This does not include tenders or opportunities that are subject to conditions, separate evaluation or selection.

What is the difference between registration, subscription and contracting?

Registration is to create an account on the platform.

As for subscription, it means joining one of the categories of freelancers and the benefits and requirements associated with it.

Contracting is the acceptance or signing of the agreement that regulates the relationship between the freelancer and the platform, and includes the work mechanism, commissions, dues, obligations, and violations.

Account creation alone does not constitute final acceptance of work or a guarantee of receipt of orders.

faq.questionAr: ثانيًا: التدريب والتأهيل ،
faq.questionEn: Second: Training and qualification,
faq.answerEn:
What initial training does a freelancer receive?

Initial training provides basics that help the freelancer understand the order execution cycle, and includes the principles of content writing, design, and programming, how to read client requirements, organize files, complete the order elements, and deliver it according to the required standards.

Many design and programming requests require writing content, organizing information, or preparing a description and details, so the freelancer is trained to deal with the request as an integrated project, not just a separate task.

Does the free training cover all advanced skills?

no. The free training is foundational and initial training, and focuses mainly on writing content and understanding the mechanism of executing requests and work requirements on the platform.

As for advanced training in graphic design, professional content writing, website programming and smart phone applications, it falls within advanced training programs or categories, including the Diploma in Digital Employment in Self-Employment.

What is a digital employment diploma in self-employment?

It is a three-month advanced qualification program that includes intensive tracks in:

Graphic design.
Advanced content writing.
Website programming.
Smart phone application development.
Applying skills within a freelance environment and executing requests.

Program details, duration, fees and outcomes are subject to the contract or offer announced at the time of registration.

Does completing training guarantee orders or profits?

Training increases a freelancer's readiness and chances of being approved and nominated for orders, but it does not represent a guarantee of a certain number of orders or profits.

The distribution of orders depends on the category of the freelancer, the results of his evaluation, the quality of his previous work, the speed of his response, his commitment, and the availability of orders appropriate to his specialization.

faq.questionAr: ثالثًا: طبيعة العمل والطلبات
faq.questionEn: Third: The nature of work and demands
faq.answerEn:
Is working at OrderzHouse a job with a fixed salary?

no. Working through OrderzHouse is freelance work, not a traditional job with a fixed monthly salary, unless there is a separate and explicit employment contract.

The freelancer receives financial compensation for the requests or tasks that he carries out and are approved, after applying the commissions and deductions agreed upon in the contract or category.

Is there work every day?

It is not necessary to have daily requests for every freelancer; Because orders are related to actual client needs, project specializations, seasons, and the volume of activity on the platform.

Requests may be available continuously in some periods, and their number may decrease in other periods. The possibility of orders appearing and receiving them also varies according to the category of the freelancer, his evaluation, and his commitment.

Is work available all year round?

The platform operates year-round, and orders can be posted and executed throughout the year. However, the number, type, and distribution of requests to freelancers may vary from time to time according to clients’ needs and the level of demand in the market.

How does the freelancer receive the request?

The freelancer's eligible orders appear according to his specialty, category, and account powers, or he is nominated and the order is distributed to him according to the platform's system.

The freelancer must review all requirements, ensure that he is able to implement it within the deadline, and not accept the order if he is not able to complete it with the required quality.

Does the freelancer have to complete the entire order?

Yes. Upon acceptance of the order, the freelancer is obligated to implement all the requirements described within the scope of work, and not only the part that falls under his primary specialization.

The order may include research, content writing, design, programming, edits, file organization, and preparation of the final version. If the request requires a multidisciplinary team, it can be managed within the internal team system or Ghost Team.

What is the Ghost Team system?

It is an internal operating system that allows the order to be managed by one or more freelancers under the supervision of the platform, without the need to show all team members to the client.

This system helps support the freelancer, address deficiencies, and redistribute part of the work or replace the executor when necessary, with the aim of maintaining as much as possible the quality of the work and the delivery date.

Can a freelancer reject an order?

The freelancer may not accept the order before confirming it if it is outside his specialty or he cannot implement it within the specified conditions.

However, after the request is finally accepted or assigned, it must be adhered to, and it is not permissible to withdraw without a legitimate reason and notifying the platform, otherwise this may affect the evaluation, powers, and level of the account.

faq.questionAr: رابعًا: فئات المستقلين
faq.questionEn: Fourth: Categories of freelancers
faq.answerEn:
What are the categories of freelancers at OrderzHouse?

Freelancers are classified into three main categories:

General or non-accredited freelancer:
A registered user has not completed all certification, contracting, or qualification requirements, and his or her ability to view or receive orders may be limited.

Certified freelancer:
Independent Complete the requirements specific to their category, such as profile, contract, training, evaluation and acceptance policies.

Certified and Verified Freelancer:
Independent Complete a higher level of verification, contracting and qualification, which may include verification of identity, professional data, subscription and category-specific quality requirements.

Does the freelancer category affect orders and profits?

Yes. The category may affect the type of orders a freelancer can access, nomination priority, size of projects, level of follow-up, and work distribution mechanism.

But the category does not guarantee a fixed income or a specific number of orders, and the quality of performance, commitment and evaluation remain key factors.

Can the freelancer category be upgraded?

Yes, the category can be upgraded after completing specific requirements, such as training, evaluation, contract update, identity verification, and payment of category fees or subscriptions if any.

The platform reserves the right to accept or postpone the upgrade based on performance, commitment, and availability of category requirements.

faq.questionAr: خامسًا: الدخل والمقابل المالي
faq.questionEn: Fifth: Income and financial compensation
faq.answerEn:
How much can a freelancer earn monthly?

There is no fixed amount that can be guaranteed. Earnings vary according to the number of completed orders, the value of each order, the type of specialization, the category of the freelancer, the quality of implementation, the speed of completion, and the time he devotes to working on the platform.

Some freelancers may earn more than others, and no examples or past results are a guarantee of future results.

How much does a freelancer earn?

There is no fixed monthly salary; Because the relationship is based on self-employment. The freelancer receives financial compensation for the work he carries out, which is approved, according to the value of the order, its conditions, and the commissions or deductions specified in the agreement.

When does the order amount become due to the freelancer?

The compensation entitlement procedures begin after the work is submitted, reviewed, and approved, and it is ensured that there is no dispute or existing amendment request.

Receivables are subject to a processing period of thirty business days from the date of final approval, unless the contract or order stipulates a different period.

When are freelancers’ dues paid?

After the processing period is completed, the amount is included in the available disbursement cycle from the first day until the tenth day of the due month.

Example: If the period of thirty working days is completed before the disbursement cycle, the amount is included in the nearest disbursement cycle between the first day and the tenth day, in accordance with financial review procedures and the availability of correct withdrawal data.

Why is there a period of thirty working days before payment?

This period is used to complete the financial review, approve the order, process any amendments or complaints, verify payments, settle commissions, and review freelancer data.

The processing period does not mean dropping the freelancer’s right to the approved amount, but rather organizing the review and disbursement cycle in accordance with the agreement.

How does a freelancer receive his profits?

Dues are currently disbursed through approved and available transfer methods, and may include transfer via exchange companies or other payment methods announced by the platform.

The beneficiary's data must be identical to the freelancer's documented data, and the freelancer may bear transfer fees or exchange differences according to what appears to him or what is stipulated in the contract.

Will there be a card available to withdraw profits?

The platform is currently working on issuing MasterCard or similar payment cards to qualified freelancers, with the aim of enabling them to receive and withdraw profits more easily.

The card may be issued and delivered to the freelancer in his country when the service is available, the order is accepted, and the required verification, fees, and procedures are completed.

This service is under trial and development, and is not available or guaranteed for all countries or for all freelancers except after the official announcement and confirmation of the user’s eligibility.

Who bears the exchange and transfer fees?

Transfer and exchange fees and currency differences are determined according to the payment method, country, and service provider policy.

The fees must be explained to the freelancer in the agreement or when submitting a withdrawal request, and the actual fees may be deducted from the transferred amount unless the platform announces them.

Are profits subject to taxes?

The freelancer is responsible for knowing his tax obligations and disclosing his income in accordance with the laws of the country in which he resides or works, unless the law requires the platform to make a specific deduction or reporting.

The Platform is not a tax advisor to the freelancer.

faq.questionAr: سادسًا: التواصل مع العملاء
faq.questionEn: Sixth: Communication with clients
faq.answerEn:
Is communication between the freelancer and the client direct?

Yes, direct communication can take place through the chat system and approved tools within the site, allowing documentation of instructions, notes, and deliverables.

It is not permissible to transfer the communication outside the platform or attempt to reach the client through phone, mail or social media without the express approval of the platform.

Why should communication be within the platform?

Communication within the platform helps document agreements, protect both parties, review instructions when a dispute occurs, and prevent fraud or changing the scope of work in an undocumented manner.

The platform may not be able to protect the freelancer or the client in transactions that take place outside its systems.

Is it permissible for the freelancer to agree with the client outside the platform?

no. It is prohibited to communicate with the aim of executing the order or collecting the financial compensation outside the platform, or providing direct services to the client in order to bypass the system, the commission, or the policies of OrderzHouse.

This is considered a fundamental violation that may lead to the suspension of the account, an investigation into the requests and dues associated with the violation, and a claim for compensation when there is proven damage.

Seventh: Account suspension and violations
Can a freelancer's account be disabled?

Yes, an account can be suspended or restricted for violation of policies or contracts, provision of incorrect information, repeated poor performance, non-delivery of orders, violation of intellectual property rights, attempted fraud, or communication with the client outside the platform.

The suspension may be temporary until the investigation is completed or permanent for serious or repeated violations.

Can the payment of dues be stopped if there is a violation?

Disbursements related to a violation or dispute may be temporarily suspended until the review is completed, especially when there is an allegation of fraud, an incomplete order, a client refund, off-platform communication, or an intellectual property dispute.

Not all receivables may be considered automatically forfeited. Undisputed amounts are settled in accordance with the contract and the law, with the amounts, damages or recoveries due when proven.

What violations may lead to account closure?

Serious violations include, for example:

Fraud or providing false data or documents.
Plagiarism or infringement of intellectual property rights.
Communication or financial agreement with the client outside the platform.
Leaking client data or files.
Accepting the request and then abandoning it without notice or legitimate reason.
Using someone else's account or allowing others to use the account.
Abuse, threats or blackmail.
Manipulating reviews, orders or payments.
Using the platform to carry out illegal acts.

faq.questionAr: ثامنًا: الدول والجهة المسؤولة
faq.questionEn: Eighth: Countries and the responsible party
faq.answerEn:
Is it possible to work as a freelancer from any country?

Yes, freelancers from different countries can be accepted, subject to the availability of verification and payment methods, and the absence of legal or operational restrictions on the country or user.

Batman Technology Company focuses on supporting and replacing Jordanian competencies and expanding digital job opportunities for Jordanians, without this meaning preventing cooperation with qualified freelancers from Arab countries or other countries.

What company is responsible for managing freelancers’ affairs?

Batman Technology Company, based in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan - Amman, is responsible for managing the operational, contractual and follow-up aspects related to freelancers on the OrderzHouse platform, in accordance with the legal data published on the site and approved contracts.

Is the freelancer an employee of Batman Technology?

no. The principle is that the freelancer works as an independent service provider, and no work, employment, salary, or social security relationship is established simply by registering or executing orders, unless there is a written, independent employment contract that expressly stipulates otherwise.

faq.questionAr: هل يمكنني العمل من الهاتف فقط؟
faq.questionEn: Can I work from the phone only?
faq.answerEn: It depends on the type of request. Programming, design, and file management work often require a suitable computer and a stable Internet connection, and a phone alone may not be enough to fulfill all requests.

faq.questionAr: هل يجب أن أكون متفرغًا بالكامل؟
faq.questionEn: Do I have to be completely free?
faq.answerEn: Full time is not required, but a freelancer should not accept an order that he cannot complete on time. Delay or poor response affects the account evaluation and chances of obtaining new orders.

faq.questionAr: هل يجوز استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي في تنفيذ الطلبات؟
faq.questionEn: Is it permissible to use artificial intelligence to process requests?
faq.answerEn:
Artificial Intelligence tools may be used where the Client does not prohibit this, and provided that the outputs are reviewed, their accuracy and originality are guaranteed, and that they do not violate the Client’s intellectual property rights or privacy.

The freelancer remains responsible for the final work, and automated deliverables that are not reviewed or that are in violation of the order requirements are not accepted.

faq.questionAr: من يملك حقوق العمل بعد التسليم؟
faq.questionEn: Who owns post-handover work rights?
faq.answerEn:
The agreed upon rights are transferred to the client after the order is approved and its value is paid, according to the description of the order, the contract, and the intellectual property policy.

The freelancer retains the rights to previous tools or templates that he owns before the order, unless the transfer is agreed in writing.

faq.questionAr: ماذا يحدث إذا طلب العميل تعديلات؟
faq.questionEn: What happens if a client requests modifications?
faq.answerEn: The freelancer implements the modifications included in the scope of the request. Amendments that change the scope of the project or add new work can be counted as an additional request or a new financial and duration adjustment.

faq.questionAr: ماذا أفعل إذا كانت متطلبات الطلب غير واضحة؟
faq.questionEn: What do I do if the order requirements are not clear?
faq.answerEn: Clarification must be requested within the platform before implementation begins or as soon as possible. It is not recommended to assume or perform work different than required without documented client or supervisor approval.

faq.questionAr: هل يمكنني امتلاك أكثر من حساب؟
faq.questionEn: Can I have more than one account?
faq.answerEn: No, except with written approval from the platform. Creating multiple accounts to circumvent rating, restrictions or commissions may result in the suspension of all associated accounts.

faq.questionAr: ماذا يحدث إذا تأخرت في تسليم الطلب؟
faq.questionEn: What happens if I am late in delivering the order?
faq.answerEn:
The rating may be reduced, the order may be redistributed, or a financial or administrative measure may be applied in accordance with the contract, especially if the freelancer has not informed the platform in advance.

The reason, circumstances, extent of the freelancer’s cooperation and the impact of the delay on the client shall be taken into account.

faq.questionAr: هل يمكنني إلغاء اشتراكي؟
faq.questionEn: Can I cancel my subscription?
faq.answerEn: Cancellation is subject to the Membership Plan terms, contract and refund policy. Canceling a subscription does not automatically mean a refund of all fees, especially after you activate benefits, start training, or use tier services.

faq.questionAr: هل يمكن إعادة رسوم الاشتراك؟
faq.questionEn: Can the subscription fee be refunded?
faq.answerEn: Redemption eligibility is determined by the reason for the request, date of payment, and whether the account has been activated, training has been provided, or orders and benefits are available.

faq.questionAr: ما هو العمل الحر؟
faq.questionEn: What is freelancing?
faq.answerEn: Freelancing is providing services or implementing projects in exchange for pay, without being tied to a traditional job or a fixed monthly salary. The freelancer works on specific requests or projects, and receives financial compensation after the work is implemented and approved according to the agreement.

faq.questionAr: ماذا تعني كلمة فريلانسر؟
faq.questionEn: What does the word freelancer mean?
faq.answerEn: A freelancer, or freelancer, is a person who provides his professional services independently to clients or companies through specific projects and requests. He is not considered a permanent employee of the Client or the Platform, unless there is a separate employment contract that expressly stipulates this.

faq.questionAr: هل العمل الحر مناسب للمبتدئين؟
faq.questionEn: Is freelancing suitable for beginners?
faq.answerEn: Yes, a beginner can enter the field of self-employment if he is willing to learn, train, and adhere to implementation standards. The platform may provide foundational training that helps the freelancer understand how to receive, execute, and deliver an order correctly.

faq.questionAr: هل يجب أن تكون لدي خبرة سابقة؟
faq.questionEn: Do I need to have previous experience?
faq.answerEn: Previous experience is not required in all cases, but some advanced orders or categories may require previous skills, evaluations, or work. A beginner can start with training and qualification, then gradually move on to more specialized orders.

faq.questionAr: هل يجب أن أكون قويًا في اللغة الإنجليزية؟
faq.questionEn: Do I have to be strong in English?
faq.answerEn:
Advanced English language proficiency is not required for all orders, but knowledge of the basics helps in using software, understanding technical terminology, and handling some files and instructions.

Some requests may require a specific level of English, and the freelancer must not accept any language request that he cannot implement with the required accuracy.

faq.questionAr: هل أحتاج إلى شهادة جامعية؟
faq.questionEn: Do I need a university degree?
faq.answerEn:
A university degree is not required for all areas of freelancing. The eligibility of a freelancer depends primarily on his skills, training, quality of work, and commitment.

Some specialized projects may require an academic qualification or professional certificate, and this is mentioned in the order conditions when necessary.

faq.questionAr: هل أحتاج إلى جهاز لابتوب أو حاسوب؟
faq.questionEn: Do I need a laptop or computer?
faq.answerEn:
Most programming, design, advanced content writing, and file management work requires a suitable computer or laptop, as well as a stable Internet connection.

The freelancer must have the necessary software and tools to fulfill the order, unless the platform or client states otherwise.

faq.questionAr: هل أستطيع العمل باستخدام الهاتف فقط؟
faq.questionEn: Can I work using only the phone?
faq.answerEn:
The phone can be used to monitor the account, respond to messages, and review some simple requests, but it is often not enough to carry out professional projects in programming, design, or file management.

It depends on the nature of the request and the software required to implement it.

faq.questionAr: هل يوجد عمر محدد للعمل كمستقل؟
faq.questionEn: Is there a specific age to work as a freelancer?
faq.answerEn:
The User must be legally able to enter into contracts and accept the terms of the Platform. The platform may require reaching a specific legal age, or obtaining guardian approval when allowing the use of the platform for those under the legal age, in accordance with applicable laws and policies.

Additional age requirements may apply to certain payment methods, contracts or services.

faq.questionAr: متى أستطيع البدء بالعمل؟
faq.questionEn: When can I start working?
faq.answerEn:
You can start after creating an account, completing the data, choosing the appropriate category, and completing the required subscription, contracting, training, or verification requirements.

The implementation of any request does not begin until it is officially assigned to the freelancer through the platform.

faq.questionAr: هل توجد عقود رسمية؟
faq.questionEn: Are there formal contracts?
faq.answerEn:
Yes, the freelancer may be asked to accept or sign a contract that regulates his relationship with the platform, and specifies the method of work, commissions, dues, obligations, violations, intellectual property rights and confidentiality.

Some requests may also require additional contracts or commitments depending on the nature of the project or client requirements.

faq.questionAr: هل الاشتراك في المنصة إلزامي؟
faq.questionEn: Is subscription to the platform mandatory?
faq.answerEn:
It depends on the type of account, category and orders the freelancer wants to reach. Subscription is mandatory for some categories of fixed-price orders according to the plans and conditions published on the platform.

Tenders or other opportunities may have different and separate terms.

faq.questionAr: هل العمل الحر مضمون؟
faq.questionEn: Is freelancing guaranteed?
faq.answerEn:
Freelancing does not guarantee a fixed number of orders or a specific monthly income. The availability of work depends on the needs of clients, the freelancer’s specialization, category, evaluation, quality of performance, speed of response, and the size of market demand.

The platform works to provide an environment and job opportunities, but registration or subscription may not be considered a guarantee of profit or continued receipt of orders.

faq.questionAr: هل يوجد راتب ثابت؟
faq.questionEn: Is there a fixed salary?
faq.answerEn: There is no fixed monthly salary; Because work is based on implementing requests and projects. The freelancer receives the financial compensation allocated for each request executed and approved, after applying the agreed upon commissions and deductions.

faq.questionAr: كم يمكن أن أكسب؟
faq.questionEn: How much can I earn?
faq.answerEn:
Earnings vary from one freelancer to another depending on the number of requests, the value of each project, the type of specialization, the category of the freelancer, the quality of implementation, the time spent, and the availability of client requests.

Any numbers or past experience are no guarantee of similar future income.

faq.questionAr: كيفية استخدام التطبيق؟ كيف اعمل على أوردرزهاوس
faq.questionEn: How to use the application? How do I work on OrderzHouse
faq.answerEn:
👋 Welcome to OrderzHouse OrderzHouse

Start with simple steps to activate your account and get started.

1. Complete the mandatory training
Watch the required lessons and carry out the required tasks within the platform.

2. Training ladder
After completion, submit your project or required assignment through the site to be evaluated.

3. Activate the account
After the training is reviewed and approved, your account will be activated and you are eligible to work.

4. Start receiving business
After activation you can:

Apply for available tenders. Receiving confirmed orders from clients. Carrying out business and generating income through the platform.

💡 The goal of training is to ensure that you are ready to work and raise the quality of services provided to clients, which increases your chances of obtaining projects on an ongoing basis.

Start training now 🚀

faq.questionAr: هل توجد ساعات دوام ثابتة؟
faq.questionEn: Are there fixed working hours?
faq.answerEn:
There is no fixed daily shift in the original; Because the freelancer manages his own time. However, it adheres to the deadlines specified for each request, and to respond and follow up within the reasonable period required.

Some projects may require presence or communication at specific times, and this must be made clear before the request is accepted.

faq.questionAr: هل توجد أوقات ذروة للطلبات؟
faq.questionEn: Are there peak times for orders?
faq.answerEn:
The number of orders may increase in some periods depending on seasons, campaigns, and the needs of companies and clients. There are no fixed or guaranteed peak times for all specialties.

The freelancer is advised to monitor the platform regularly and maintain the readiness of his account and the speed of its response.

faq.questionAr: هل يوجد عمل كل يوم؟
faq.questionEn: Is there work every day?
faq.answerEn:
There is no requirement for every freelancer to have daily requests. This depends on the volume of client orders, the freelancer's specialization, category, rating, and suitability to available orders.

There may be active periods and less active periods, and the platform is not obligated to provide daily work.

faq.questionAr: هل أستطيع العمل وأنا طالب أو موظف؟
faq.questionEn: Can I work while I am a student or employee?
faq.answerEn:
Yes, it is possible to work part-time as long as the freelancer is able to adhere to deadlines and quality of implementation, and does not have contractual or legal restrictions that prevent him from practicing additional work.

It is the freelancer's responsibility to review their current employment contract and any obligations related to conflicts of interest, confidentiality, or competition.

faq.questionAr: هل العمل مناسب لمن يحتاج إلى مرونة في الوقت أو المكان؟
faq.questionEn: Is the job suitable for someone who needs flexibility in time or space?
faq.answerEn:
Yes, the nature of freelancing often allows for remote work and flexible time management. However, adherence to order requirements, timeliness, quality of delivery, and regular communication remains the priority.

The suitability of the work depends on the nature of the tasks, the tools required, and the freelancer’s ability to implement them.

faq.questionAr: ماذا أفعل إذا كنت أخشى عدم النجاح؟
faq.questionEn: What should I do if I'm afraid of not succeeding?
faq.answerEn:
Start with foundational training and requirements appropriate to your level, and do not accept a project that you do not understand or cannot implement. Review the instructions, ask for clarification before starting, and benefit from supervisor reviews and adjustments to improve your level.

Success in self-employment depends on continuous learning, discipline, quality implementation, and building a good professional record, not on registration alone.

Terms and conditions of use of the OrderzHouse platform
Date of last update: 20-7-2026

These Terms and Conditions constitute a binding electronic agreement governing the use of the OrderzHouse Platform and the relationship between the Platform, its operating company, clients, freelancers, and all users.

Batman Technology Company owns and operates the OrderzHouse platform from the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, and is referred to in these terms, depending on the context, as the “Company” or “Operator.”

Registering an account, activating it, paying any fees, posting an order, accepting a project, submitting a Bid, or using any of the platform’s services is an acknowledgment that the user has read, understood, and agrees to these terms and the policies and contracts associated with them.

If the User does not agree to these terms, he must stop using the Platform and not create an account or carry out any transaction through it.
1. Arrange protection and responsibilities

These conditions aim to organize rights and obligations in the following order:
1.	Protect the OrderzHouse platform, systems, rights, reputation and business continuity.
2.	Protection of Batman Technology Company as the owner, operator and legal representative of the platform.
3.	Protecting the client's rights to documented orders, payments and deliveries.
4.	Protecting the rights of the freelancer in the executed works and approved dues.
This arrangement does not mean canceling any mandatory right established by law for any party, but rather defines the operational and contractual framework for managing the platform and protecting the interests of its users.

2. Definitions
For the purposes of these Terms, the following words have the meanings set forth below:
Platform: OrderzHouse website and its associated systems, applications, control panels and services.
Company: Batman Technology Company, registered and operating in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, as the owner and operator of the OrderzHouse platform.
User: Every natural or legal person who uses the platform in any capacity.
Client: A user who posts an order, purchases a service, or funds a project through the platform.
Freelancer: An independent service provider that executes orders or submits Bids through the platform.
Request: Any task, service, or project published or assigned through the platform.
Fixed-price order: An order whose requirements and value have been determined, approved and funded, and are ready to be assigned to a qualified freelancer.
Bidding: A project that allows freelancers to submit technical or financial Bids before selecting the executor.
Wallet: An electronic record within the client’s account that shows the balance available to be used to purchase orders or other services within the platform.
Dues: The amounts that become due to the freelancer after the order is executed, delivered, and approved, and after deducting the approved commissions, fees, and deductions.
Ghost Team: An internal operating system that allows the request to be managed by one or more freelancers or oversight and review teams without requiring all team members to be visible to the client.

3. Nature of the platform
OrderzHouse provides an electronic environment for managing orders and services between clients and freelancers, and its services include, depending on the case:
• Publishing requests and tenders.
• Receiving Bids and assigning projects.
• Organizing payments and wallets.
• Manage correspondence and delivery.
• Quality review and modifications.
• Operating the Ghost Team system.
• Complaints and disputes management.
• Processing freelancers’ dues.

The Platform may intervene administratively and operationally in the project, change the freelancer, redistribute the work, request modifications, or assign an additional team, when this is necessary to protect the order, the client or the platform.

The platform does not guarantee the freelancer a specific number of orders or a fixed income, nor does it guarantee the client a specific commercial result or financial profit, unless a written and express commitment is issued by the company to the contrary.

4. Independence of the personality of OrderzHouse and the operating company
OrderzHouse is the brand and operational platform through which services are provided, while Batman Technology Company is responsible for management, operation, contracting, collection, and legal follow-up within the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.
The use of the name OrderzHouse or any associated trademark shall not be construed as creating an independent company separate from the legal entity shown in the Site Data, Contracts and Invoices.

The company shall have the right to:
• Platform management.
• Establish policies and fees.
• Accept or reject accounts.
• Review orders and transactions.
• Taking legal action.
• Protecting the brand, systems and databases.

5. Relationship with freelancer
The Freelancer acts as an independent Service Provider at his or her own professional and financial risk, and is not an employee, worker, agent or partner of OrderzHouse, Batman Technology Inc. or the Client.
Registration, subscription, training, or executing orders do not create any rights associated with traditional employment, including:
• A fixed monthly salary.
• Fixed job hours.
• Paid vacations.
• End of service compensation.
• Employment-based social security.
• Exclusivity of work.
• Commitment to provide a minimum number of orders.
The freelancer manages his time, tools, and method of work, while adhering to order specifications, deadlines, quality instructions, and supervision.
This description remains in place unless there is an independent written employment contract, or a binding ruling is issued by a competent judicial authority that readjusts the relationship in accordance with the facts and the law.

6. User eligibility
The user is required to have the necessary legal capacity to create an account, conclude contracts, and carry out financial transactions.
If a person uses the Platform on behalf of a company, organization or other entity, he or she represents that he or she is legally authorized to accept these Terms and to act on its behalf.

The platform may request:
• Proof of identity.
• Proof of age.
• Proof of residence address.
• Payment or transfer data.
• Commercial registration data.
• Proving the validity of the representation.
• Any information necessary for compliance or fraud prevention.

7. Accounts and data
The user is obligated to enter correct, complete and up-to-date data.

It is prohibited:
• Impersonation.
• Using forged documents.
• Recording incorrect data.
• Create multiple accounts to circumvent.
• Account sale or transfer.
• Enabling others to use it without consent.
• Hide the real beneficiary of the account.
• Using the account to carry out illegal acts.
The user bears full responsibility for the operations carried out from his account unless he immediately reports a proven hack or unauthorized use to the platform.

8. Categories of freelancers
Freelancers may be classified into:
General or unaccredited freelancer
A user who has not completed all verification, training, or contracting requirements, and whose authority may be limited.

Certified freelancer
An independent who fulfills the basic requirements set by the platform, including contracting, training, evaluation, and acceptance of policies.

Certified and verified freelancer
Independent that has met a higher level of verification, qualification, contracting and engagement, in accordance with applicable requirements.

The platform may modify, reduce, or suspend the freelancer's category based on performance, violations, expiration of subscription, or failure to complete requirements.
A class or certification badge is not an absolute guarantee of the quality of each freelancer's work or income.

9. Subscriptions and freelance fees

The platform determines the value of subscriptions, activation fees, duration, and benefits on the Membership Plans page or the freelancer’s contract.
The Freelancer acknowledges that the subscription and activation fees correspond to the availability of services and benefits, account operation, access to systems, orders, training or tools associated with the Class.

Non-refundable freelancer fees

Subscription, activation, and training fees are non-refundable after activating a freelancer's account, enabling Membership Plan benefits, starting training, or granting access to orders, whether:
• The freelancer used the services or not.
• Did he get requests or not?
• Continue working or stop voluntarily.
• His account was suspended due to a violation on his part.
• His personal or professional circumstances changed.
• He did not achieve the income he expected.

The freelancer does not have the right to transfer the subscription to another person or demand that it be exchanged for a cash amount.
The exception to this is only what the company decides in writing, or what is required to be recovered under a binding legal provision that may not be agreed to be violated.

10. Subscription does not represent a financial investment
The subscription fee is not a deposit, investment or contribution to the platform's capital.
The freelancer is not granted:
• Share in the company.
• A right to public profits.
• Guaranteed return.
• A guaranteed number of orders.
• A salary or monthly income.
• Absolute priority over other freelancers.
A freelancer's earnings depend on the orders he actually fulfills and are approved, his category, specialization, quality of performance, and availability of client orders.

11. Fixed price orders
A fixed price order is an order created by the client, specifying its requirements and value, and its value has been paid or its financing has been approved within the platform.
When the request is assigned to a freelancer and he accepts it, he is committed to implementing it completely in accordance with:
• Description of the request.
• Attached files.
• The software or technology required.
• Specifications and sizes.
• Delivery format.
• The specified period.
• Client and management instructions within the scope of the request.
The freelancer is not entitled to compensation simply because the request is accepted, but rather after the work is executed, delivered, and approved in accordance with the conditions.

12. Tenders
Tenders allow qualified freelancers to submit technical and financial Bids to implement a specific project.
Neither the Platform nor the Client is obligated to accept:
• First Bid.
• Lowest-priced Bid.
• A particular Freelancer Bid.
• Any Bid that does not meet the requirements.
The freelancer is prohibited from starting implementation before an official award is issued through the platform.

13. Execute the request
The freelancer is responsible for reading the order and ensuring that he is able to implement it before acceptance.
The freelancer is obligated to use the program, technology or work method specified in the order or management instructions.
He may not change the programme, formula or methodology in any material way without documented approval.
The freelancer is committed to the following:
• Submit complete and original work.
• Punctuality.
• Review the work before delivery.
• Providing source files upon request.
• Implementing the included amendments.
• Maintaining confidentiality.
• Respect intellectual property rights.
• Do not include malicious software.
• Do not use pirated software or components.
• Review any AI generated content.

14. Ghost Team system
The Client and Freelancer agree that the Platform has the right to manage the order through the Ghost Team system.
The platform may:
• Add a supervisor or reviewer.
• Division of work between more than one freelancer.
• Replace the faltering freelancer.
• Re-implementation of part of the project.
• Addressing shortages without showing all internal procedures to the client.
• Share files with team members necessary for implementation, while respecting confidentiality.
The system aims to reduce the impact of any shortcomings on the client and maintain as much as possible the quality and timeliness of the project.

15. Communication within the platform
All correspondence, agreements, deliveries and payments relating to the Order must be made through OrderzHouse.
The client and the freelancer are prohibited from:
• Exchanging phone or email numbers with the intention of bypassing the platform.
• Agreement to pay outside the site.
• Convert the request into a direct relationship.
• Try to avoid commissions and fees.
• Attracting the other party outside the platform.
• Hiding influential correspondence or agreements.
• Share another user's data without permission.
Correspondence recorded within the Platform constitutes operational evidence that may be referred to in disputes and investigations.

16. Misuse and abuse
Each user bears full civil and criminal liability for any content, message or behavior issued by him.
In particular, it is prohibited:
• Insulting, cursing, or belittling.
• Defamation and harm of reputation.
• Threat or blackmail.
• Harassment or harassment.
• Spreading false information.
• Impersonation.
• Data leakage.
• Hacking accounts or systems.
• Spreading malicious files.
• Fraud or financial manipulation.
• Insulting the platform, its employees, or its users.
• Publishing incorrect claims with the intention of causing commercial harm.
Neither OrderzHouse nor the Company shall be held liable for the personal expressions or violations committed by the Client or the Freelancer, and the perpetrator shall remain directly responsible for them.

17. Legal measures against the violating user
When a freelancer or client commits a transgression or violation, the platform may take one or more of the following actions:
• Give a warning.
• Delete content.
• Restrict conversations.
• Stop the request.
• Account suspension.
• Permanently close the account.
• Suspension of amounts related to the violation.
• Preserving electronic records and evidence.
• Requesting compensation from the violator.
• Notify the payment provider.
• Submit a complaint to the competent authorities.
• Cooperation with judicial and security authorities.
If the user is outside Jordan, the company may take the measures available in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, refer the information or file a complaint to the competent authorities in the user’s country when possible, and seek the assistance of local and international legal representatives or advisors.
Mention of these procedures does not constitute an obligation on the Company to take a particular action, and it reserves the right to choose the most appropriate action.

18. User liability for abuse
The client and the freelancer acknowledge that they alone bear full legal responsibility for any abuse, violation or damage caused by them.
The violating party is obligated to compensate OrderzHouse and Batman Technology Company, its directors, employees and partners for damages, claims, expenses and legal fees resulting directly from its violation, to the extent permitted by law.
It is not permissible to use the platform as a means to spread abuse and then demand that the company bear the consequences of the user's personal action.

19. Client order value
When an order is created and paid for, the amount is allocated to execute that order according to the approved system.
If the order is cancelled, cannot be executed, or the platform decides to return its value, the value due to the client will be returned to his wallet within OrderzHouse, unless the law or a binding decision requires it to be returned in another way.

20. Refund the client value to the wallet
The full approved value is returned to the client to his wallet within the platform in cases where OrderzHouse decides to cancel the order without due execution, the service cannot be provided, or a full refund request is accepted.
The client can use the credit to create another order or purchase other services available on OrderzHouse.

Wallet balance properties
• The balance remains valid for use without a specified expiration period, as long as the account and platform exist.
• The balance is not a bank deposit.
• It does not entail interest or returns.
• It may not be sold or transferred to another user without consent.
• It may not be used outside of OrderzHouse.
• Cash is not withdrawn unless the company agrees in writing or the law requires otherwise.
• It may be frozen upon suspicion of fraud, financial objection, or policy violation.

If the Client pays in a currency different from the Wallet Currency, the balance may be calculated according to the value actually received by the Platform after payment gateway fees and currency differences, unless the full refund is inclusive of these fees by law or company decision.

21. Cancellation after implementation begins
If the freelancer initiates the fulfillment of the order, the client is not automatically entitled to a full refund.
The platform may, depending on the status of the request:
• Approval of the completed part.
• Allocating compensation to the freelancer for usable work.
• Return the remaining portion to the client’s wallet.
• Reassign the order to another freelancer.
• Request to complete or modify the work.
• Refund the full value if it is proven that there is no usable benefit.
Platform decisions are based on order description, correspondence, deliverables and review reports.

22. Non-refundable payment fees
Payment gateway fees, transfer fees, currency differences, or any fees actually incurred by the platform may be excluded from the refund, if they are non-refundable from the service provider and permitted by law.
Any material deduction will be stated to the client when the case is processed.

23. Consumer rights
For a client located within the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, the relationship is subject to the provisions of Jordanian laws in force, including mandatory consumer protection rules when applicable.
Batman Technology Company represents and operates the OrderzHouse platform within the Kingdom, and handles complaints and official communication according to its published data.
No clause in these terms may be construed as abolishing a mandatory right that Jordanian law does not permit to be waived.
For clients outside Jordan, these terms and Jordanian law apply to the extent permissible, without excluding any peremptory rule in the consumer country that is applicable by law.

24. Delivery and modifications
The freelancer delivers work upon request and in specified formats.
The client is obligated to review the delivery and send notes within the specified period.
The order includes only modifications within its original scope.
Changes that add new work or fundamentally change the project require:
• Additional request.
• Price adjustment.
• Modifying the implementation period.
• Documented consent.

25. Approval of the request
The order is approved when:
• Client approval.
• Platform management approval after review.
• The review period expires without objection, if automatic approval is implemented and announced.
Certification does not prevent subsequent investigation of fraud, intellectual property infringement, or serious hidden defects.

26. Freelance dues
The order value does not become due to the freelancer until:
1.	Complete the work.
2.	Delivered through the platform.
3.	Implementing the included amendments.
4.	Final approval of the order.
5.	End of any influential dispute.
6.	Settlement of commissions and fees.
Receivables are subject to a processing period of thirty business days from the date of final approval, unless the contract stipulates a different period.
After the end of the processing period, the receivables are included in the disbursement cycle from the first day until the tenth day of the receivable month.
The expiration of thirty business days does not mean that the transfer must be made on the same day, but rather that the receivable be included in the nearest completed payment cycle.

27. Means of disbursing dues
The freelancer's dues are disbursed using approved and available means, including exchange companies, transfers, or payment providers.
The freelancer is obligated to provide correct data that matches his identity.
The freelancer shall bear the fees and currency differences imposed by the conversion provider, unless the platform decides otherwise.
The platform is working on issuing MasterCard or similar payment cards and delivering them to qualified freelancers in their countries.
The card is not considered an acquired right or a guaranteed service until final approval, verification, fees, and geographic coverage are completed.

28. Suspending the freelancer’s dues
The amount associated with a request or violation may be suspended until the investigation is completed, including:
• Incomplete work.
• There is a dispute.
• The client objects to payment.
• Fraud or suspected fraud.
• Impersonation.
• Using stolen works.
• Breach of confidentiality.
• Communication or collection outside the platform.
• The existence of a legal claim.
• Causing loss or financial recovery.
A temporary suspension does not mean that all of the freelancer's funds are automatically forfeited.
The company may conduct clearing and deduct the amounts owed to it or the client, or the value of damage or recovery, whenever it is proven in accordance with the contract, settlement, or legal decision.

29. Failure to protect foreign transactions
The platform does not provide any protection for a transaction, agreement or payment made outside OrderzHouse.
If the client and freelancer communicate outside the platform or make a direct payment, they:
• They bear the full risks of dealing.
• They lose the right to rely on the platform’s guarantees related to that transaction.
• They remain responsible for violating the terms of use.
• Their account may be suspended or closed.
• They may be charged fees or compensation for fraud.

30. Intellectual property
The freelancer guarantees that the work he or she submits:
• Original or licensed.
• Does not violate the rights of others.
• Does not include pirated elements.
• It does not violate the terms of the programs or libraries used.
After the order is approved and its value is paid, the rights specified in the order description or contract are transferred to the client.
Tools, libraries, templates, and components that the freelancer owned before the project do not automatically transfer, unless the agreement stipulates this.
The party submitting illegal or unauthorized material assumes full responsibility for it.

31. Confidentiality and data protection
The client and the freelancer are obligated not to disclose or use the information, files and data they obtain except to fulfill the request.
Information may be shared within the OrderzHouse or Ghost Team to the extent necessary for implementation, review and support.
The Platform may retain records, correspondence and files for as long as necessary for operational, legal and security purposes.
Data processing is subject to the Privacy Policy and applicable legislation.

32. Prohibited use
It is prohibited to use the platform for:
• Fraud and money laundering.
• Hacking systems.
• Malicious software.
• Impersonation.
• Manipulating evaluations.
• Intellectual property theft.
• Posting illegal content.
• Abuse, threats and defamation.
• Collect user data without permission.
• Fraudulent fees.
• Disabling the platform or testing its security without permission.
• Using its services to harm any person or entity.

33. Ratings
Reviews must be honest and based on actual experience.
Prohibits:
• Buy reviews.
• Share fake reviews.
• Using evaluation for blackmail.
• Publishing unproven accusations.
• Evaluating a person without actually interacting.
The platform may delete, hide, or keep the review as internal evidence when it violates the policies.

34. Account suspension and closure
The account may be suspended, restricted or closed if the terms are violated or there is a legal, security or financial risk.
The company may take the decision without prior notice in serious cases, including:
• Fraud.
• Penetration.
• Threat.
• Forgery.
• Business theft.
• Off-platform collection.
• Data leakage.
• Intentional harm to the platform’s reputation.
• Repeated non-execution of requests.
When the account is closed, the outstanding orders and amounts are reviewed and settled in accordance with these terms, contracts and legal obligations.

35. Compensation
The User is obligated to indemnify OrderzHouse and Batman Technology Company for direct damages, claims and reasonable expenses resulting from:
• Violating the conditions.
• Violating the rights of others.
• Providing false information.
• Insulting or defaming him.
• Fraud or deception.
• Violating laws.
• His illegal use of the platform.
Compensation shall only be applied to the extent permitted by law, after the cause has been proven and the user is responsible.

36. Limits of liability of the platform and the company
The Platform takes reasonable measures to protect orders and users, but does not guarantee continuous operation without malfunctions.
Neither the Platform nor the Company shall, to the extent permitted by law, be liable for:
• Expected profits or opportunities.
• Internet or payment providers interruptions.
• Foreign transactions.
• User errors.
• Loss of login data.
• Information incorrectly provided by the client.
• An independent default that is dealt with according to the system.
• Events beyond control.
• Decisions of government agencies or service providers.
This exemption does not include liability which may not be legally excluded, fraud or proven gross error.

37. Taxes
The client and freelancer are responsible for their tax and financial obligations in their country.
The company may deduct or disclose amounts or data when required by law.
The platform does not provide personal tax advice.

38. Force majeure
Neither the platform nor the company shall be liable for delays or inability resulting from events beyond reasonable control, including:
• Disasters.
• Wars and disturbances.
• Government decisions.
• General communications outage.
• Payment systems malfunction.
• Widespread electronic attacks.
• International circumstances that prevent transfers.
In these cases, the period may be extended, the service may be suspended, or the amounts may be returned to the wallet according to the case.

39. Law and jurisdiction
These terms are governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.
Disputes are first attempted to be resolved through the complaints and resolution system within OrderzHouse.
When settlement is not possible, the competent Jordanian courts have jurisdiction over the dispute, unless a peremptory law requires other jurisdiction or there is a valid agreement on an alternative means.
The company may submit complaints and prosecute the violating user in Jordan or in his country of residence if the competent authorities there have jurisdiction and the procedure is legally available.

40. Modify the terms
The Platform may modify these terms, services, fees or policies.
The new version will be published with its effective date, and the user will be notified of fundamental changes when needed.
Retroactive amendments do not affect approved receivables, except where there is a legal reason, consent, fraud or apparent error.

41. Priority of documents
In the event of a conflict, priority shall be in the following order:
1.	Signed private contract.
2.	Conditions for the approved order.
3.	Membership Plan and Subscription Terms.
4.	terms of use.
5.	General policies and guidelines.

42. Separability of items
If any term is found invalid or unenforceable, this shall not affect the remaining terms.
The clause shall be amended or interpreted to the extent that most closely matches its legal and commercial purpose.
