The OrderzHouse platform respects the privacy of its users, and Batman Technology Company, as the company that owns and operates the platform, is committed to protecting the personal data of the client and the freelancer and processing it in accordance with applicable legislation and approved policies.

Data we collect
We may collect data that the user provides to us when registering or using the platform, including:
• Name, identity data, age, nationality, and country of residence.
• Phone number, email and address.
• User photo, profile and professional data.
• Qualifications, skills, experience and business models.
• Data of the company or organization that the client represents.
• Data on requests, projects, proposals, deliverables and evaluations.
• Correspondence conducted through the platform.
• Subscription, billing, payments, wallet and dues data.
• Bank or exchange account information or means of receiving profits.
• Documents necessary to verify identity and combat fraud.
• Device and browser information, connection address, login and usage logs.
• Cookies and similar technologies.
The platform does not ask the user to send personal or financial data that is not necessary to provide the service, and passwords, secret numbers, or data that are not required should not be shared through conversations.

Purposes of data use
The data is used for the purposes necessary to operate OrderzHouse, including:
• Create, activate and manage the account.
• Verify the user’s identity and eligibility.
• Classifying freelancers and determining their powers and categories.
• Manage subscriptions, Membership Plans, and training.
• Publishing requests, tenders, and awarding projects.
• Enabling communication between the client and the freelancer.
• Operating the Ghost Team system and reviewing the quality of work.
• Process payments, wallets, receivables and transfers.
• Issuing invoices and financial records.
• Executing deliveries, modifications and approving orders.
• Handling complaints, disputes and violations.
• Combating fraud, impersonation and financial fraud.
• Protect the security of the platform and users.
• Improving services and user experience.
• Sending account-related notifications and requests.
• Compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
• Defend the rights of OrderzHouse, the company and users.
Sensitive data is not used for purposes not related to the Service without a legal basis or necessary consent.

Legal basis for processing
The platform processes data based on one or more of the following bases:
• User consent.
• Implementing the contract or taking action before contracting.
• Implementing a legal or regulatory obligation.
• Protect the legitimate rights and interests of the platform and users.
• Prevent fraud and protect systems security.
• Establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
The user can withdraw his consent to consent-based processing, but this does not affect the lawfulness of the previous processing, and may prevent the continued provision of some services that require that data.

Data sharing
OrderzHouse does not sell personal data to advertisers or other third parties.
Data may be shared to the extent necessary with:
• Batman Technology Company employees and authorized persons.
• The client or freelancer associated with the request.
• Supervisors and Ghost Team members needed for implementation and review.
• Hosting, technical and security services providers.
• Payment gateways, banks, exchange and transfer companies.
• Entities that issue or deliver payment cards when the service is available.
• Auditors, accountants, consultants and lawyers.
• Competent governmental, judicial or security authorities.
• Any other party with which the user agrees to share his data.
Everyone who receives the data is obligated to use it within the limits of the specified purpose, and to take appropriate measures to protect it.

Requests and correspondence data
The platform may view and review correspondence and files related to requests when necessary:
• Providing technical and operational support.
• Verify the execution of the request.
• Follow up on quality and delivery.
• Handling complaints and disputes.
• Discover communication or payment outside the platform.
• Prevent fraud or abuse.
• Implementing a legal obligation.
Platform conversations must not be used to send personal or financial data that is not necessary to carry out the project.

International data transfer
Because OrderzHouse may be used from different countries, data may be hosted, processed or transferred to service providers located outside of the user's country.
The Platform takes reasonable measures to protect data when transferred internationally, in accordance with available legal and contractual requirements.

Data retention period
The Platform retains data for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes of its collection, operate the account, enforce contracts, process payments and disputes, and comply with legal, tax, and accounting requirements.
Some records may continue to be retained after the account is closed if they are necessary:
• To prove transactions and contracts.
• To protect legal rights.
• To address complaints or disputes.
• To prevent fraud and repeat violations.
• To carry out a legal or judicial obligation.
After the legal or operational need has ended, the data will be deleted or its owner's identity will be anonymized to the extent possible.

Data protection
The platform applies reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data, including:
• Determine access permissions.
• Use appropriate protection and encryption methods.
• Monitoring attempts at entry and illegal use.
• Maintain copies and operational records when needed.
• Review security incidents.
• Restricting employees’ and service providers’ access to data.
However, absolute protection for any electronic system cannot be guaranteed, and the user bears responsibility for protecting his password, device, and login data, and for notifying the platform immediately upon suspicion that his account has been hacked.

User rights
Depending on applicable law, the user may request:
• Know the data that is processed about it.
• Access his data and obtain a copy of it.
• Correct or supplement inaccurate data.
• Update account information.
• Object to some types of processing.
• Withdraw consent when it is the basis for processing.
• Request deletion of data or restriction of its use when permitted by law.
• File a complaint regarding the processing of his data.
The Platform may reject or postpone the request if retaining the data is necessary to perform a contract, process receivables, protect legal rights, investigate a wrongdoing, or comply with a legal obligation.
The platform may request verification of the identity of the applicant before responding to it.

Cookies
The Platform may use cookies and similar technologies to:
• Keep the user registered in his account.
• Save his settings and preferences.
• Account protection and fraud prevention.
• Measuring site performance.
• Analyze usage and improve services.
• Display appropriate content or notifications.
The user can control some cookies from the browser settings, but disabling necessary cookies may affect the operation of the platform.

Communications and notifications
The Platform may send messages related to account, orders, payments, security and terms updates, as necessary to provide the Service.
As for marketing messages, the user can unsubscribe from them through the available means, without this affecting the necessary operational or legal messages.

Data of minors
Anyone who does not have legal capacity may not create a contractual account or use payment and withdrawal services without the approval of his guardian or legal representative, and when the platform’s approval is required.
If it is found that an account was created in violation of these terms, the account may be suspended and unnecessary data deleted, while retaining what is necessary to prove transactions or protect rights.

External links and services
The Platform may contain links or services provided by third parties, such as payment gateways or transfer providers.
These parties' processing of data is governed by their own privacy policies, and OrderzHouse is not responsible for the practices of a third party not managed by it, taking into account the platform's responsibilities established by law.

Modify the privacy statement
This Statement may be updated as the Services are developed or regulations or legal requirements change.
The updated version will be published with its effective date, and the user may be notified of material modifications through the account, email, or registered means of communication.

Communication and privacy requests
To exercise your rights or submit a privacy inquiry or complaint, you may contact:

Batman Technology Company
The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan - Amman
Email: info@orderzhouse.com
Website: OrderzHouse.com
By using the OrderzHouse platform or creating an account there, the user acknowledges that he has read the privacy statement and understands how his data is collected, used and protected in accordance with this statement and applicable laws.

Guaranteeing client rights

At OrderzHouse we work to protect client rights through clear procedures to regulate order creation, scope of work, payment, execution, delivery, modifications, and project approval.

Order details, correspondence, and deliveries are documented within the platform, which helps to refer to them when any dispute occurs. The client can also follow the status of his project from the time the order is published until its closing, and request a review or amendment according to the agreed upon scope of work.

When there is an implementation problem, the platform can review the request, correspondence, and delivered files, and intervene to address deficiencies or redistribute work within the Ghost Team system when needed, in accordance with the platform’s policies.

Any agreement, payment or communication related to the Project outside OrderzHouse is not recommended; Because platform protection and complaints and dispute mechanisms mainly apply to documented processes within it.

For more details, please review the Terms of Use, Payment and Refund Policy, Privacy Policy, and Complaints and Disputes Mechanism.



Guaranteeing the rights of the freelancer

At OrderzHouse, we work to protect the rights of the freelancer by documenting the assignment of the order, its financial value, requirements, implementation period, required modifications, delivery status and approval within the platform.

After the order is executed, delivered, and approved, the financial consideration enters the review and processing cycle, and then the dues are disbursed according to the period and payment mechanism approved in the platform and the freelancer’s contract.

The platform provides channels for review and objection when there is disagreement about the scope of work, delivery, modifications, or dues. The status is evaluated by referring to the order description, correspondence, files delivered, and evidence available within the system.

To benefit from this protection, it is necessary to execute the order, communicate and deliver through the platform only, and not to agree with the client or receive any amounts outside it.

Amounts associated with a disputed request or violation may be temporarily suspended until the review is completed, but this does not mean that undisputed receivables will be forfeited. The final settlement takes place in accordance with the contract, platform policies, and applicable law.

For more details, please review the freelancer contract, terms of use, earnings and withdrawal policy, privacy policy, and complaints and dispute mechanism.

# OrderzHouse Blog

Practical articles and tips on freelancing, project management, dealing with clients and freelancers, and implementation and delivery best practices.

#How to start freelancing in the right way?
Freelancing has become one of the most flexible work models, as it allows a person to offer his skills and services to different clients in exchange for a specific fee for each project or request. But success in this field does not depend only on creating an account and waiting for opportunities, but rather it requires learning, organization, and commitment.

# Choose a clear niche
Start with a field you understand the basics of or can develop your skills in, such as content writing, graphic design, programming, data entry, or digital marketing.

Don't try to provide all services from the beginning; Choosing a clear field helps you develop your skills and build a stronger professional portfolio.

# Continuously develop your skills
Skill is the basis of a freelancer's work. Take advantage of training and educational resources, and apply what you learn to pilot projects.

Your learning should not only be limited to the technical aspect, but also include:

* Understanding client requirements.
* Organize files.
* Time management.
* Use appropriate software.
* Review work before delivery.
* Professional communication.

Some design and programming work requires supporting skills such as content writing, research, and information organization, so the order must be treated as an integrated project.

# Prepare work tools
Most professional work requires a suitable computer or laptop, a stable Internet connection, and the software required to carry out the work.
The phone can be used to follow up on messages and requests, but it is often not enough to carry out professional projects in programming, design, or file management.

# Review the order before accepting it
Before accepting any order, read the description, files, outputs and duration required.

Make sure you are able to implement the entire project, and do not rely on the order title only. If the instructions are not clear, ask for clarification through the platform before starting work.

Accepting a request that exceeds your capabilities or available time may result in delays, a lower rating, and the project being reassigned to another freelancer.

# Commit to communicating within the platform
Correspondence, agreements and deliveries shall be made through OrderzHouse.
This helps document instructions and protect the rights of the client and the freelancer when any dispute occurs. You should also avoid agreeing to pay or carrying out work outside the platform; Because foreign transactions do not benefit from approved protection and review systems.

# Pay attention to the quality of delivery
It is not enough to finish the task quickly. Review the files and ensure they match the required sizes, formats and requirements.
Attach source files if included in the order, and write a delivery letter stating:
* What has been implemented.
* Attached files.
* How to use files.
*Any important notes to the client.

# Don't expect a fixed salary
Freelancing is not a traditional job, so there is usually no fixed monthly salary or guaranteed number of orders.
Income varies according to specialization, category of freelancer, quality of performance, number of requests, value of each project, time spent, and volume of client requests.
Start by building a good portfolio of work and reviews, then gradually move on to larger, more specialized projects.

# Article summary
Success in freelancing requires skill, discipline, clear communication, and professional delivery. Start with orders appropriate to your level, learn from each project, and do not accept work that exceeds your ability without obtaining appropriate training and qualifications.



#How to manage your project with a freelancer and get better delivery?

The success of the project does not depend on the skill of the freelancer alone, but rather begins with the client’s ability to clarify his needs and provide the information necessary for implementation.
The more organized and specific the request, the faster and more accurate the pricing, execution and review process.

# Write a clear description of the project
Start by clarifying the goal of the project, not just the name of the task.
Instead of typing “I want a design,” select:
*Design type.
* Required size.
* The platform on which it will be published.
* Target audience.
* Colors and visual identity.
* Texts and information.
* Final file format.

In programming projects, pages, features, user types, permissions, payment methods, integrations, and required technologies, if any, must be clarified.

# Select the desired output
Clearly state the files you expect to receive when the project is finished, such as:
* Final files.
* Source files.
* Editable version.
* Codes and databases.
* User guide.
* Different sizes and formats.
* Login data or delivery method.

Failure to define the outputs from the beginning may lead to a discrepancy between the client’s expectations and what the freelancer understands from the request.

# Attach references and available materials
Provide the freelancer with the necessary logo, colors, texts, images, files, and visual or technical references.
A client's delay in sending requested materials may result in a delay in implementation, even if the freelancer is committed to his work.
The client must also ensure that he has the right to use the materials he sends, especially images, fonts, trademarks, and protected content.

# Set the budget and duration realistically
The budget and duration must fit the size of the project.
A project that requires content writing, design, programming, testing, and delivery of multiple files cannot be treated as a simple task.

Some projects may be managed through a Ghost Team system, with more than one freelancer or supervisor working on different parts of the project to ensure its completion and address any shortcomings during implementation.

# Document communication within the order
Keep all instructions, approvals and amendments within OrderzHouse.
Do not rely on unauthenticated external calls or messages; Because it may cause disagreement about what was agreed upon.
When adding a new requirement, it must be made clear whether it is included in the original order or requires additional cost and duration.

# Gather your notes before sending them
When you receive the initial copy, review the entire project and compile your feedback into one clear, organized message.
Sending feedback sporadically may confuse the implementation process and lengthen the project duration.
A distinction must also be made between modification and changing the scope of work:
Modifying is correcting or improving a part included in the project, while adding a new page, feature, design, or service is additional work that requires a new agreement and pricing.

# See on-time delivery
Open and test the files as soon as you receive them, and make sure they are complete and working as intended.
In technical projects, test:
*Links.
* Models.
* the accounts.
* Powers.
* Payment methods.
* Compatibility with phone and computer.
* Basic functions of the project.

Submit any objection or comment within the specified review period, then approve the order after ensuring it is complete.

# Keep the project confidential and secure
Only send sensitive passwords when needed, and use subaccounts or temporary privileges when possible.
It is recommended that passwords be changed after the project ends if the freelancer is given access to internal accounts or systems.
Correspondence, files, and deliverables must also be kept inside the platform to ensure their documentation and protection.

# Article summary
Clear demand, defined deliverables, completed materials, documented communication, and structured review are the key elements for a better outcome.
OrderzHouse helps the client manage these stages, from order posting and freelancer selection, through to implementation, delivery and approval.

blocks.titleAr: كيف تعمل كمستقل عبر أوردرز هاوس؟
blocks.bodyAr:
كيف تعمل كمستقل عبر أوردرز هاوس؟
1. إنشاء الحساب

أنشئ حسابًا كمستقل، وأدخل بياناتك الأساسية ووسائل التواصل ومجالات العمل التي ترغب في تنفيذ الطلبات ضمنها.

قد تطلب المنصة التحقق من الهوية والبيانات الشخصية والمهنية قبل تفعيل بعض الخصائص أو السماح بسحب المستحقات.

2. اختيار فئة المستقل

يتم تصنيف المستقلين في المنصة ضمن ثلاث فئات:

مستقل عام أو غير معتمد.
مستقل معتمد.
مستقل معتمد وموثّق.

تختلف صلاحيات الوصول إلى الطلبات وأولوية الترشيح ومستوى المتابعة بحسب الفئة، والعقد، والاشتراك، ومتطلبات التحقق والتأهيل.

3. إتمام الاشتراك والتعاقد

يُعد الاشتراك في الفئة المخصصة للطلبات ذات السعر الثابت من متطلبات تفعيل العمل على هذه الطلبات.

يجب على المستقل قبول سياسات المنصة وإتمام العقد والمتطلبات المرتبطة بفئته. ولا يشمل ذلك المناقصات، التي قد تخضع لإجراءات اختيار وتقييم منفصلة.

4. التدريب والتأهيل

يحصل المستقل في البداية على تدريب تأسيسي يساعده على فهم آلية تنفيذ الطلبات، وقراءة متطلبات العميل، وتنظيم الملفات، وكتابة المحتوى الأساسي، وتسليم الطلب بصورة مكتملة.

تتطلب كثير من أعمال التصميم والبرمجة إعداد محتوى ووصف وتنظيم معلومات، لذلك يتم تأهيل المستقل للتعامل مع الطلب بوصفه مشروعًا متكاملًا.

أما التدريب المتقدم في كتابة المحتوى والتصميم الجرافيكي وبرمجة المواقع وتطبيقات الهواتف، فيتوفر ضمن البرامج والفئات التدريبية المتقدمة، ومنها دبلوم التشغيل الرقمي في العمل الحر.

5. ظهور الطلبات واستلامها

تظهر للمستقل الطلبات المتاحة وفق تخصصه، وفئته، وتقييمه، وصلاحيات حسابه، أو يتم ترشيحه إليها وفق نظام توزيع الطلبات.

يجب مراجعة تفاصيل الطلب والمدة والمخرجات المطلوبة قبل قبوله. ولا يجوز قبول طلب لا يستطيع المستقل تنفيذه كاملًا وبالجودة المطلوبة.

6. تنفيذ الطلب

يلتزم المستقل بتنفيذ جميع المتطلبات المحددة في الطلب، بما في ذلك المحتوى، والتصميم، والبرمجة، والتعديلات، والملفات النهائية، بحسب نطاق العمل.

قد تتم إدارة بعض الطلبات من خلال نظام «Ghost Team»، بحيث يعمل أكثر من مستقل أو مشرف خلف الطلب لضمان استمرارية التنفيذ ومعالجة أي تقصير داخليًا.

7. التواصل داخل المنصة

يتم التواصل مع العميل من خلال نظام المحادثات والأدوات المعتمدة داخل أوردرز هاوس.

يُمنع التواصل مع العميل خارج المنصة، أو محاولة الحصول على بياناته، أو الاتفاق معه بصورة مباشرة لتجاوز المنصة أو عمولتها.

8. التسليم والمراجعة

يُسلّم العمل من خلال الطلب نفسه، مع إرفاق جميع الملفات والمخرجات المطلوبة.

قد يطلب العميل أو فريق المراجعة تعديلات تقع ضمن نطاق العمل. أما الأعمال الإضافية أو التي تغيّر نطاق الطلب، فتحتاج إلى اتفاق جديد أو تعديل في السعر والمدة.

9. اعتماد الطلب

بعد التسليم، تتم مراجعة العمل والتأكد من مطابقته للمتطلبات وعدم وجود تعديلات أو نزاعات قائمة.

يصبح المقابل المالي مؤهلًا للمعالجة بعد اعتماد الطلب نهائيًا.

10. معالجة المستحقات

تخضع المستحقات لفترة معالجة مدتها ثلاثون يوم عمل من تاريخ الاعتماد النهائي، ما لم ينص العقد أو الطلب على مدة أخرى.

تُستخدم هذه الفترة للمراجعة المالية، والتحقق من المدفوعات، وتسوية العمولات، ومعالجة أي شكاوى أو استردادات مرتبطة بالطلب.

11. صرف الأرباح

بعد اكتمال مدة المعالجة، يتم إدراج المستحقات ضمن دورة الصرف المتاحة من اليوم الأول وحتى اليوم العاشر من الشهر المستحق.

يتم الصرف حاليًا من خلال وسائل التحويل المعتمدة، ومنها شركات الصرافة، بحسب الدولة وتوفر الخدمة وصحة بيانات المستقل.

تعمل المنصة كذلك على تجربة إصدار بطاقات دفع من نوع ماستركارد أو بطاقات مماثلة، يتم إصدارها وإيصالها إلى المستقل في بلده عند توفر الخدمة واستكمال شروط الأهلية والتحقق.

12. الحفاظ على الحساب

يؤثر الالتزام بالمواعيد، وجودة التنفيذ، وسرعة الاستجابة، والتقييمات، وعدم مخالفة السياسات في استمرار الحساب وإمكانية الوصول إلى الطلبات.

قد يتم تعليق الحساب أو تقييده عند الإخلال بالطلبات، أو تقديم معلومات غير صحيحة، أو محاولة التواصل مع العميل خارج المنصة، أو ارتكاب أي مخالفة تعاقدية أو قانونية.
blocks.titleEn: How to work as a freelancer through OrderzHouse?
blocks.bodyEn:
How to work as a freelancer through OrderzHouse?
1. Create account

Create an account as a freelancer, and enter your basic data, means of communication, and areas of work within which you would like to fulfill orders.

The platform may request verification of identity and personal and professional data before activating certain features or allowing the withdrawal of dues.

2. Choose the freelancer category

Freelancers on the platform are classified into three categories:

General Freelancer or unaccredited.
Certified Freelancer.
Certified and Verified Freelancer.

Request access, nomination priority, and follow-up level vary by tier, contract, subscription, verification and qualification requirements.

3. Completion of subscription and contract

Participation in the category designated for fixed price orders is a requirement to activate work on these orders.

The freelancer must accept the platform's policies and complete the contract and requirements associated with their category. This does not include tenders, which may be subject to separate selection and evaluation procedures.

4. Training and qualification

The freelancer initially receives foundational training that helps him understand the mechanism of executing orders, reading the client’s requirements, organizing files, writing basic content, and delivering the order completely.

Much of the design and programming work requires preparing content, describing, and organizing information, so the freelancer is qualified to handle the request as an integrated project.

As for advanced training in content writing, graphic design, website programming, and phone applications, it is available within advanced training programs and categories, including the Digital Employment Diploma in Self-Employment.

5. Appearance and receipt of orders

The available orders are displayed to the freelancer according to his specialty, category, rating, and account powers, or he is nominated for them according to the order distribution system.

The order details, duration, and required deliverables must be reviewed before acceptance. It is not permissible to accept a request that the freelancer cannot implement completely and with the required quality.

6. Execute the request

The freelancer is obligated to implement all requirements specified in the order, including content, design, programming, modifications, and final files, depending on the scope of work.

Some requests may be managed through the “Ghost Team” system, with more than one freelancer or supervisor working behind the request to ensure continuity of implementation and address any shortcomings internally.

7. Communication within the platform

Communication with the client takes place through the approved chat system and tools within OrderzHouse.

It is prohibited to communicate with the client outside the platform, attempt to obtain his data, or agree with him directly to bypass the platform or its commission.

8. Delivery and review

The work is delivered through the order itself, with all required files and deliverables attached.

The client or review team may request modifications that are within the scope of work. Additional works or those that change the scope of the order require a new agreement or an amendment to the price and duration.

9. Approval of the request

After delivery, the work is reviewed to ensure that it conforms to the requirements and that there are no existing modifications or disputes.

The consideration becomes eligible for processing after the order is finally approved.

10. Processing receivables

Dues are subject to a processing period of thirty working days from the date of final approval, unless the contract or order stipulates another period.

This period is used for financial review, verification of payments, settlement of commissions, and processing of any complaints or refunds associated with the order.

11. Disbursement of profits

After the processing period is completed, the receivables are included in the available disbursement cycle from the first day until the tenth day of the receivable month.

Currently, exchange is carried out through approved means of transfer, including exchange companies, depending on the country, the availability of the service, and the accuracy of the freelancer’s data.

The platform is also working on issuing MasterCard payment cards or similar cards, which will be issued and delivered to the freelancer in his country when the service is available and the eligibility and verification conditions are completed.

12. Maintain the account

Punctuality, quality of execution, speed of response, ratings, and non-violation of policies affect account persistence and accessibility of requests.

The account may be suspended or restricted if you violate orders, provide incorrect information, attempt to communicate with the client outside the platform, or commit any contractual or legal violation.

تُفرض رسوم تفعيل سنوية مقدارها 25 دينارًا أردنيًا على حساب المستقل، وتُدفع مرة واحدة سنويًا، وفق الشروط المعروضة عند الاشتراك.

تشمل الباقات المتاحة:

الباقة الأساسية المجانية، وتناسب المستقلين في بداية العمل، ويبلغ الحد الأعلى للأرباح من خلالها 100 دينار أردني شهريًا.

الباقة المتقدمة لمدة شهر واحد بقيمة 20 دينارًا أردنيًا، وتتيح أرباحًا غير محدودة خلال مدة الاشتراك.

الباقة المميزة لمدة سنة واحدة بقيمة 45 دينارًا أردنيًا، وتتيح أرباحًا غير محدودة طوال مدة الاشتراك.

باقة برو بلس لمدة سنتين بقيمة 65 دينارًا أردنيًا، وتتيح أرباحًا غير محدودة طوال مدة الاشتراك.

الباقة البلاتينية لمدة سنة واحدة، وتشمل دبلوم التشغيل الرقمي في العمل الحر، والتدريب المتقدم في كتابة المحتوى، والتصميم الجرافيكي، والبرمجة باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي. تبلغ القيمة الإجمالية للباقة 900 دينار أردني، ويُدفع منها 300 دينار عند الاشتراك، ثم 50 دينارًا شهريًا لمدة 12 شهرًا.

يمكنك مقارنة الباقات واختيار الباقة المناسبة من صفحة خطط الاشتراك. ولا يضمن الاشتراك تحقيق دخل ثابت أو الحصول على عدد محدد من الطلبات، إذ يعتمد ذلك على فئة المستقل، وتخصصه، وتقييمه، وجودة أدائه، وتوفر طلبات العملاء.

تتوفر فرص العمل على أوردرز هاوس من خلال نوعين رئيسيين من الطلبات: طلبات السعر الثابت والمناقصات.

طلبات السعر الثابت هي طلبات أنشأها العميل وحدد متطلباتها وقيمتها المالية، وتم اعتمادها ودفع قيمتها عبر المنصة. يكون الطلب جاهزًا للتنفيذ وينتظر إسناده إلى مستقل مؤهل.

عند إسناد طلب السعر الثابت إلى المستقل، يصبح مسؤولًا عن تنفيذه كاملًا وفق الوصف والمواصفات والمدة المحددة. وبعد التسليم والاعتماد، يستحق المستقل المقابل المالي المخصص للطلب وفق شروط المنصة والعمولات المعتمدة.

أما المناقصات، فهي فرص يعلن فيها العميل عن مشروعه ويتيح للمستقلين المؤهلين تقديم عروضهم، وقد يتضمن العرض السعر المقترح، ومدة التنفيذ، وخطة العمل، والخبرة ذات العلاقة. يراجع العميل أو فريق المنصة العروض، ثم يتم اختيار العرض الأنسب وفق متطلبات المشروع، وليس بالضرورة العرض الأقل سعرًا.

تظهر الطلبات والمناقصات للمستقل بحسب تخصصه، وفئته، وتقييمه، وصلاحيات حسابه. ويجب على المستقل مراجعة جميع المتطلبات والملفات والمدة قبل قبول الطلب أو تقديم العرض، والتأكد من قدرته على تنفيذ العمل كاملًا بالجودة المطلوبة.

لا يعني ظهور الطلب للمستقل ضمان إسناده إليه، كما لا يجوز البدء بالتنفيذ قبل تأكيد الإسناد رسميًا من خلال المنصة.

Job opportunities on OrderzHouse are available through two main types of orders: fixed price orders and tenders.

Fixed price orders are orders created by the client, whose requirements and financial value are specified, and which are approved and paid for through the platform. The order is ready to be executed and waiting to be assigned to a qualified freelancer.

When a fixed price request is assigned to a freelancer, he becomes responsible for its complete implementation according to the description, specifications, and specified period. After submission and approval, the freelancer is entitled to the financial compensation allocated to the order according to the platform’s terms and approved commissions.

As for tenders, they are opportunities in which the client announces his project and allows qualified freelancers to submit their Bids. The Bid may include the proposed price, implementation period, work plan, and relevant experience. The client or platform team reviews the Bids, and then the most appropriate Bid is chosen according to the project requirements, and not necessarily the lowest price.

Requests and tenders appear to the freelancer according to his specialty, category, rating, and account powers. The freelancer must review all requirements, files, and duration before accepting the order or submitting the Bid, and ensure his ability to complete the work with the required quality.

The appearance of the request by the freelancer does not guarantee that it will be assigned to him, nor may implementation begin before the assignment is officially confirmed through the platform.

بعد إسناد الطلب، يراجع المستقل جميع التفاصيل والمتطلبات والملفات المرفقة قبل بدء التنفيذ. يجب تنفيذ المشروع باستخدام البرامج والأدوات المناسبة لطبيعة الطلب، أو باستخدام البرنامج المحدد من العميل أو إدارة المنصة، إن وُجد.

يلتزم المستقل بتنفيذ العمل بالطريقة والصيغة والمقاسات والمواصفات المطلوبة، واتباع تعليمات العميل وإدارة المنصة، ما دامت ضمن نطاق الطلب ولا تخالف القوانين أو سياسات أوردرز هاوس.

يجب على المستقل التأكد من أن العمل مكتمل، وقابل للاستخدام، وخالٍ قدر الإمكان من الأخطاء، وأن جميع الملفات النهائية والمصادر المطلوبة مرفقة بالتنسيقات المحددة.

عند وجود تعليمات غير واضحة أو تعارض بين المتطلبات، يجب على المستقل طلب التوضيح من خلال المنصة قبل الاستمرار، وعدم إجراء تغييرات جوهرية أو استخدام برنامج بديل دون موافقة موثقة.

قد تتابع إدارة المنصة مراحل التنفيذ وتطلب تحديثات أو نماذج أولية أو تعديلات قبل التسليم النهائي. كما يمكنها الاستعانة بنظام Ghost Team لمعالجة أي نقص، أو دعم المستقل، أو توزيع أجزاء من المشروع على مختصين آخرين عند الحاجة.

يبقى المستقل مسؤولًا عن جودة العمل الذي ينفذه، وعن الالتزام بحقوق الملكية الفكرية، وسرية بيانات العميل، وعدم استخدام ملفات أو برامج أو محتوى غير مرخص.

بعد تسليم الطلب واعتماده نهائيًا، يصبح المقابل المالي الخاص بالمستقل مؤهلًا للدخول في دورة المراجعة والمعالجة المالية وفق شروط المنصة.

تخضع المستحقات لفترة معالجة مدتها ثلاثون يوم عمل تبدأ من تاريخ الاعتماد النهائي للطلب، ما لم ينص العقد أو تفاصيل الطلب على مدة مختلفة. وتُستخدم هذه الفترة للتحقق من اكتمال التسليم، واعتماد المبلغ، وتسوية العمولات والاقتطاعات، ومعالجة أي تعديلات أو شكاوى أو نزاعات مرتبطة بالطلب.

بعد انتهاء مدة المعالجة، تُدرج المستحقات ضمن دورة الصرف المعتمدة من اليوم الأول وحتى اليوم العاشر من الشهر المستحق. ولا يُعد انتهاء مدة الثلاثين يوم عمل التزامًا بالصرف الفوري في اليوم نفسه، بل يتم الصرف ضمن أقرب دورة مالية تالية بعد اكتمال جميع إجراءات المراجعة.

يتم تحويل المستحقات حاليًا من خلال وسائل الدفع والتحويل المعتمدة لدى المنصة، ومنها شركات الصرافة، بحسب الدولة وتوفر الخدمة وصحة بيانات المستقل. ويجب أن تكون بيانات المستفيد مطابقة للبيانات المسجلة والموثقة في الحساب.

قد تُخصم من المبلغ رسوم التحويل أو الصرافة أو فروقات العملات أو أي اقتطاعات متفق عليها في العقد أو مفروضة من مزود خدمة الدفع أو القانون.

تعمل المنصة حاليًا على تجربة إصدار بطاقات دفع من نوع ماستركارد أو بطاقات مماثلة للمستقلين المؤهلين، بهدف تسهيل استلام الأرباح وسحبها. وقد يتم إصدار البطاقة وإيصالها إلى المستقل في بلده بعد استكمال متطلبات التحقق والأهلية والرسوم المرتبطة بها، إن وجدت. ولا تُعد هذه الخدمة متاحة أو مضمونة لجميع الدول أو المستخدمين إلا بعد الإعلان الرسمي عنها.

يجوز للمنصة تعليق صرف المبالغ المرتبطة بطلب محل نزاع أو مخالفة أو اشتباه بالاحتيال إلى حين انتهاء المراجعة. ولا يؤدي التعليق المؤقت إلى إسقاط حق المستقل في المستحقات غير المتنازع عليها، وتتم التسوية النهائية وفق العقد وسياسات المنصة والقانون المعمول به.

After the order is submitted and finally approved, the freelancer’s financial compensation becomes eligible to enter the review and financial processing cycle according to the platform’s terms.

Receivables are subject to a processing period of thirty working days starting from the date of final approval of the order, unless the contract or order details stipulate a different period. This period is used to verify the completion of delivery, approve the amount, settle commissions and deductions, and handle any amendments, complaints or disputes related to the order.

After the end of the processing period, receivables are included in the approved disbursement cycle from the first day until the tenth day of the receivable month. The expiration of the thirty business day period does not constitute a commitment to immediate disbursement on the same day, but rather disbursement will take place within the nearest next financial cycle after all review procedures have been completed.

Dues are currently transferred through the payment and transfer methods approved by the platform, including exchange companies, depending on the country, the availability of the service, and the validity of the freelancer’s data. The beneficiary's data must match the data recorded and documented in the account.

Transfer or exchange fees, currency differences, or any deductions agreed upon in the contract or imposed by the payment service provider or law may be deducted from the amount.

The platform may suspend the disbursement of amounts related to a disputed request, violation, or suspected fraud until the review is completed.
